## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Restore `--wait` before merge because existing scripts that use it fail during the release intended to preserve compatibility.

## Changes

The pull request renames the CLI option to `--timeout`, updates the parser tests, and adds an architecture decision documenting a one-release transition. The 30-second default and the JSON and CSV format choices remain available.

## Critical

- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias for one release — `--wait 12` is rejected as an unrecognized argument because the parser registers only `--timeout`. The decision in `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says to “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` exit with status 2 during argument parsing. — Fix: Register `--wait` with the same `timeout` destination and emit the deprecation warning only when callers use that alias.
